# Cleanora AI

> Cleanora is a Windows-only desktop app that classifies filenames and metadata locally. Users can review exact destinations before applying moves. Verified supported systems: Windows 10, Windows 11.

## Official product facts

- Canonical website: https://cleanoraai.com/
- Product category: Local Windows file organizer and Downloads folder organizer
- Supported platforms: Windows 10, Windows 11
- Current lifetime price: USD 9.99
- Official purchase page: https://computora.gumroad.com/l/cleanora
- Publisher: Computora AI (https://computoraai.com/)
- Official GitHub organization: https://github.com/cleanora-ai
- Support: support@computoraai.com
- Privacy model: File scanning and classification run locally without cloud file uploads.
- Safety model: Users preview exact destinations before applying moves; Cleanora does not silently overwrite or automatically delete files.

## Core pages

- [Downloads Folder Organizer for Windows](https://cleanoraai.com/clean-downloads-folder/): Organize a crowded Windows Downloads folder by file type, metadata, or modified date. Preview exact destinations, avoid conflicts, and undo approved moves.
- [Preview File Moves Before Organizing Windows Folders](https://cleanoraai.com/preview-file-moves-windows/): Preview exact file destinations, conflicts, categories, and reasons on Windows before confirming a bulk organization plan with Cleanora.
- [Cleanora vs Cloud AI File Organizers](https://cleanoraai.com/alternatives/cloud-organizers/): Compare local Windows file organization with cloud-based AI organizers by privacy, preview control, setup, and offline use.
- [Cleanora vs File Juggler](https://cleanoraai.com/alternatives/file-juggler/): Compare Cleanora's metadata-based suggestions with File Juggler's Windows rules for moving, renaming, deleting, and document-based workflows.
- [Cleanora vs Microsoft Power Automate](https://cleanoraai.com/alternatives/power-automate/): Compare a focused local file organizer with Microsoft's broader workflow automation platform for desktop, cloud, and business processes.
- [Automatic vs Manual File Organization](https://cleanoraai.com/alternatives/manual-organization/): Compare automatic and manual file organization by setup time, review, control, scale, consistency, and the types of files each method handles best.
- [Windows File Organizer Alternatives](https://cleanoraai.com/alternatives/): Compare Cleanora with rule-based, workflow automation, cloud, and manual file organization approaches for private Windows folder cleanup.
